messages.subject: stack smashing detected
parts:
Hello,

I'm having some issues with subread-align, I've tried with 1.5.0-p1, 1.5.0-p2, 1.5.0-p3, and 1.5.1 now. After some time, the alignment crashes and aborts with the message:

*** stack smashing detected ***: subread-align terminated

Aborted (core dumped)


I'm not trying anything fancy: subread-align -i ~/DATA/subread_indices/ce10/ce10 -r ~/DATA/INTACT/gcy5test/raw/cat_corrected/g56IN.fastq.gz -o g56IN.bam -t 0


It worked once before with a different fastq file. If I separate this one into four files, it works with the first, but none of the other three. It makes me think it's something to do with my data, but I don't have any idea what it might be. 


I'm not sure what to do now. Any thanks would be greatly appreciated!


-dylan
